description: Stage exactly the named hunks of a git_commit_read hunks listing into the index. Pass the listing's digest with the ids and the same paths: the call recomputes the diff and stages nothing when it differs from the listing, so a stale listing never stages other hunks. The working tree is untouched. Ids are positions in one listing, so list again after staging. A binary file cannot be staged by hunk; stage it whole with git add.

digest.description: The digest of the git_commit_read hunks listing the ids come from.

hunks.description: The ids of the hunks to stage, from that listing; a repeated id is staged once.

paths.description: The same files or directories the listing was made with, relative to the working tree root.

name: git_commit_stage

files.description: Every file the index now changes against HEAD, including what was staged before this call.

added.description: The lines added in the index against HEAD (0 for a binary file).

file.description: The path of the file, relative to the repository root.

removed.description: The lines removed in the index against HEAD (0 for a binary file).

root.description: The absolute path of the working tree root.

staged.description: The ids of the hunks that were staged, ascending.

title: Stage chosen hunks
